10033.d: Esiplaanil roigastara, mille mulgu kohal mees aeruga õlal. Vasemal, diagonaalis pildi keskääreni ulatuv jõgi, mis keskalal ühineb suurema, järvetaolise veekoguga. Jõe kõrgemal tagakaldal lehtpuid ja torniga kivihoone. Sellest paremal, madalikul, gooti stiilis kirik. Paremal järve kaldal puude vahel rida taluhooneid. Kauguses paistab teise kiriku torni siluett. Järve pinnaleespool sõudepaat kolme sõitjaga, kaugemal purjekaid. Öises taevas täiskuu.
10033.de: In the foreground, a pole fence with a man carrying an oar over his shoulder above a gap in it. On the left, a river running diagonally to the middle edge of the picture, which in the middle area joins a larger, lake-like body of water. On the higher far bank of the river, deciduous trees and a stone building with a tower. To the right of it, on lower ground, a Gothic-style church. On the right, along the lake shore, a row of farm buildings among trees. In the distance, the silhouette of another church tower is visible. On the surface of the lake, a rowing boat with three passengers, and sailing boats further away. A full moon in the night sky.

64754.d:
Kaanel pasunat puhuv amor ja rikkaliku reljeefse ornamendi vahel tekst: Salus et Victoria. Herculis Munus, Nisi qui legitime certaverit. 
Tüveseks oleva rooma sõduri kilpi kaunistab emaileeritud mustpeade vapp. Kupa ülaosas on ovaalide sisse graveeritud annetajate vapid ja nimed: Thomas Remingt, William Beaumo(n)t, Robert Maisters, Thomas Donn, Robert Mallabar, John Cary, Gabriel Donker, Beniamin Benson, Richard Sykes, William Sill, Richard Cooke. Karikas on kaetud rikkaliku taimornamendiga ning seisab kolmel lehekujulisel jalal.
64754.de:
On the lid, a cupid blowing a trumpet, and between rich relief ornament the text: Salus et Victoria. Herculis Munus, Nisi qui legitime certaverit. 
The stem, in the form of a Roman soldier's shield, is decorated with an enamelled coat of arms of the Moor's heads. In the upper part of the cup, the coats of arms and names of the donors are engraved within ovals: Thomas Remingt, William Beaumo(n)t, Robert Maisters, Thomas Donn, Robert Mallabar, John Cary, Gabriel Donker, Beniamin Benson, Richard Sykes, William Sill, Richard Cooke. The cup is covered with rich plant ornament and stands on three leaf-shaped feet.

64888.d: Kannu kere on üleni kaetud kohrutatud ornamendiga: lõbutsevad putod maastiku taustal, hoidmas lillevanikuid, karjusekeppi ja -sarve. Baasil ja kaanel lopsakas taimornament. Kaane keskel reljeefne allianssvapp. S-kujulise sanga keskel naisefiguur (herm).
64888.de: The body of the jug is entirely covered with relief ornament: frolicking putti against a landscape background, holding garlands of flowers, a shepherd's crook and a horn. On the base and lid a lush plant ornament. In the centre of the lid a relief alliance coat of arms. In the centre of the S-shaped handle a female figure (herm).

65002.d: Kaanel pasunat puhuva rooma sõduri kuju. Nii kaanel kui ka karika jalal rikkalik reljeefne taimornament. Tüveseks kilbile toetuv rooma sõduri kuju. Kupa keskosal reljeefsed lahingustseenid ja rikkalik taimornament. Tüveseks oleva rooma sõduri kilbil on kujutatud C. G. von Wrangeli vappi. Karikas seisab kolmel konnakujulisel jalal.
65002.de: On the lid, the figure of a Roman soldier blowing a horn. Both on the lid and on the foot of the goblet, rich relief plant ornamentation. The stem is formed by the figure of a Roman soldier leaning on a shield. On the central part of the cup, relief battle scenes and rich plant ornamentation. On the shield of the Roman soldier forming the stem is depicted the coat of arms of C. G. von Wrangel. The goblet stands on three frog-shaped feet.
